parsed.headline: PIX success rate collapses to 30% on PSP Acme in BR — provider reports degraded PIX settlement

claims.text: PSP Acme's status page reports DEGRADED PERFORMANCE on PIX settlement since 09:58 UTC due to elevated timeouts at the clearing layer, with no ETA — this starts just before the 10:00–10:15 UTC anomaly window.
At least three separate merchants reported PIX problems within ten minutes, indicating the failure is not bounded to one merchant.
Merchant LojaVerde reports customers seeing 'payment failed' on PIX checkout from about 10:00 UTC, while card payments on the same checkout are unaffected — the failure is method-specific to PIX.
No internal change is implicated: nothing shipped today and the last deploy was Friday, which argues against an internal_error cause.

Classification: provider_outage, severity P1, confidence 0.88 — a provider-side degradation on the same PSP confirmed by the provider itself and corroborated by multiple merchants, with no known workaround for PIX.

parsed.suspected_cause: provider_outage — PSP Acme's PIX clearing/settlement layer is timing out, per its own status page, corroborated by multi-merchant reports and the absence of any internal change.
parsed.merchant_impact: Broad: roughly 70% of PIX attempts failing in the window (552 successes of 1840 attempts vs a 0.94 baseline), affecting at least three merchants including LojaVerde. Card payments on the same checkouts continue to work, so merchants with card fallback have partial mitigation; PIX-only flows have none.
parsed.recommended_owner: APM operations on-call — PSP Acme provider liaison (escalate to PSP Acme support and consider routing PIX volume away from psp_acme if an alternate route exists)
open_questions: Does an alternate PSP route exist for PIX in BR, and can traffic be shifted while Acme is degraded?
How many merchants and what total PIX volume are exposed to psp_acme beyond the three that reported?
Are failed attempts safely non-captured, or is there settlement ambiguity/double-charge risk from clearing-layer timeouts?
Has PSP Acme provided an ETA or incident ID since the 10:04 UTC status update?
